CUO Container Update Orchestrator
Copyright 2026 CUO contributors

This product includes modified code derived from containrrr/watchtower,
commit a047c7f9ff11813f930f6998863fa1b8a015985c (v1.7.1), Apache License 2.0.
The adapted GetCreateConfig algorithm is in internal/watchtower/config.go.
The original source archive and license are retained in third_party/.
CUO is an independent product; no official Watchtower affiliation is implied.

XTend 0.9.0, konnilabs/xtend commit
49166cbe96d91049634fbe03eb48c04edb6e70cd, Apache License 2.0.
Original license: third_party/XTend-LICENSE.
Two unused legacy HTML materialization paths are disabled in the generated
browser runtime by console/tools/harden-runtime.mjs, with hash evidence.
The upstream source is fetched as a commit/SHA-256 locked external dependency.

Roboto fonts: Copyright Google, Apache License 2.0.
Local redistributable regular and medium fonts are bundled, no remote CDN.

XRouter and XDrawer static templates are adapted to native DOM construction by
console/tools/prepare-xtend.mjs; router errors render as text. The external dependency
is retained unchanged and per-component hashes are recorded by the build.

OIDC runtime: openid-client 6.8.8, oauth4webapi 3.8.8, jose 6.2.14.
Copyright Filip Skokan and contributors, MIT License. Package licenses are
included with the runtime dependency tree installed from its lockfile.

The Agent includes a locally rebuilt Docker Compose v5.6.1-cuo.1, based on
docker/compose v5.6.1, commit 6cbc19a3fd59e305fb814dca4d854a4fb67d2941.
Copyright 2020 Docker Compose authors, Apache License 2.0.
The dependency-only security fix from upstream commit
7ad5c58b380038aed842bc1396b091e81a88a0b0 is backported in
dependencies/compose/security.patch; this is a modified build, not an official
Docker release. The source and patch are SHA-256 locked in compose.lock.
Original notices: third_party/Compose-LICENSE and third_party/Compose-NOTICE.
The Agent ships these notices, linked-module licenses, dependency lock, patch,
actual Go build info and binary checksum under /usr/share/licenses/cuo/compose/.

Product icon sources: homarr-labs/dashboard-icons, commit
83f32e08257b66fbd971ac8d7645f5b38d52e85d (Apache License 2.0 collection),
and the original Appsmith favicon from appsmithorg/appsmith, commit
7bf6d367d0d0cd2f3b3e43d9678caad2dae03ca3 (Apache License 2.0).
Source URLs and original SHA-256 values are in console/brands/sources.lock.json.
Collection licenses and upstream disclaimers are in console/brands/LICENSES.
Collection licensing does not imply ownership of the individual brand marks;
names and marks remain with their respective owners. No affiliation is implied.
CUO's build normalizes SVG presentation attributes and flattens groups/classes
to XIcon geometry. Portainer's redundant viewport clip is removed. Appsmith's
original 16-pixel favicon is represented as SVG rectangles without altering its
pixels. Original source files are retained.
